description: Adds a Twitch or Kick streamer to the user's heistclips watchlist, so their live streams and new VODs are read every 10 minutes and the moments chat explodes land in my_clip_queue as ready clips. Says which clipping campaigns pay for clips of that streamer and how many clips are ready now; when none pays yet, the user is told when one opens. Works for a streamer in any category. Answers 'watch kaicenat for me', 'tell me when X has a clip', 'follow this streamer'. The first call (no account) returns a code that carries the watchlist on later calls; the user's private queue link from the website works instead. remove stops watching.

account.description: The account code (hc_…) from an earlier call. Leave out on the very first call.

queue_link.description: Or: the private link from the user's queue page (heistclips.com/queue?k=…)

remove.description: true to stop watching this streamer

streamer.description: Twitch channel name or link, or a Kick channel as kick.com/<name>

name: watch_streamer
title: Watch a streamer for me: add a Twitch or Kick channel to my clip watchlist
